messages:
ashley (billing): Quick follow-up from the postmortem — token-count deltas + delayed usage ingestion still need concrete owners and timelines. I want a single checklist we can point customers to for invoice adjustments.

mike (reconciliation): +1. We had 34 customers affected, several requested corrected invoices. I can own outreach but need who owns the actual corrections.

devin (ingest): I dug into the consumer lag window. Root cause was a race in the batch merge that sporadically dropped late events. Patch is in review.

jana (invoicing): For corrections: our flow is manual credit + new invoice; that needs a ticket per account. If devin can produce a corrected usage file, we can start. What format do you need?

ashley (billing): Devin — can you deliver a per-account delta CSV with columns: customer_id, billed_tokens, corrected_tokens, delta_tokens, reason? That'll let Jana and Mike run corrections.

devin (ingest): Yes. I can produce that. ETA: 48h for the corrected ingestion run, then another 12h to generate CSV. Owner: devin.

ryan (eng-infra): FYI, I noticed the job retries were clobbering older batches under high load. I'll add a guard so retries don't drop previously-merged partitions. Will push a quick mitigation today.

ops-bot: Deploy started: ingester-service v2.4.1 -> staging at 2026-03-19T16:05:00Z

jana (invoicing): Once we have CSVs, do we have capacity to do the 34 manual tickets this sprint? I can do ~10, need someone to help.

sara (finance): I can pick up 12 tickets and handle the customer comms template. We should standardize the message to avoid confusion. Draft template: "We detected an ingestion issue that affected your usage for <date-range>. We have issued a credit of $X and reissued the invoice." Thoughts?

mike (reconciliation): That template works. Also want an internal note: mark corrections with adjustment_reason=INGESTION_LAG_2026-03 so billing analytics can filter.

ashley (billing): Good call. Let's capture action items here so execs can see progress:
A1: produce per-account delta CSV (owner: devin, due: 2026-03-21 16:00 UTC)
A2: harden retry guard to prevent future drops (owner: ryan, due: 2026-03-19 23:59 UTC)
A3: create customer comms + run 34 correction tickets (owners: jana + sara + mike, due: 2026-03-25)
A4: tag corrected invoices with adjustment_reason and track in analytics (owner: mike, due: 2026-03-25)
A5: run a weekly audit query for 8 weeks to detect recurring patterns (owner: ashley, due: start 2026-03-28 recurring weekly)

devin (ingest): Confirming A1. I'll add a checksum column and include raw_event_ids for a subset. Will post CSV to secure S3 and share link in #finance.

ryan (eng-infra): Confirming A2. Quick mitigation pushed to prod; I'll follow up with PR link. If we still see anomalies after patch, escalate to rollback plan.

jana (invoicing): I'll split the tickets and assign to the three of us. Please add a priority flag if any customers are enterprise contracts.

mike (reconciliation): Will add priority and a flag for customers who already disputed charges.

ashley (billing): Two process notes: 1) For transparency, we should post a short internal status doc in #finance and link to it in customer comms if asked. 2) Let's avoid bulk corrections without individual ticket traces — auditors will want traces.

sara (finance): I'll draft the internal status doc after I receive the CSV. Will include a table of affected accounts, amounts, ticket IDs.

ops-bot: CI test failed for ingester-service PR #482 — flakiness in batch-merge tests.

devin (ingest): Noted. I'm triaging the CI flakes now. If CI blocks rollout, I can run the ingestion job manually and lock the cluster for the corrected window. Will annotate manual run in the status doc.

ashley (billing): Excellent. Quick ask for measurables before we close: final corrected token total, number of invoices adjusted, aggregate credit amount, and confirmation that retry guard is live. Please update this thread when items complete.

ryan (eng-infra): Will post PR + prod flag once live.

devin (ingest): CSV link: s3://redwood-billing/private/ingest-adjustments/1802004321-deltas.csv (will set ACLs). Manual run scheduled if CI blocks.

jana (invoicing): Receiving CSV now. I'll start ticketing.

sara (finance): Drafted comms template and internal status doc stub, uploading to drive and will link here.

mike (reconciliation): I'll update analytics tags after tickets are created.

ashley (billing): Thanks all. We'll sync up in the weekly billing postmortem on 2026-03-25 to confirm closure and any recurring pattern work. If anything slips, @ashley (billing) mark me. :thumbsup:
